name: World Athletics Road Running Championships Copenhagen 26
description:
On September 19-20, 2026, the World Athletics Road Running Championships will take place in Copenhagen for an unforgettable weekend.

It’s three iconic races in One Mile, 5K, and the Half Marathon distance. It’s a fierce battle for six iconic titles and a festive event for 65,000 runners.

In other words:
3 iconic races
6 world champions
and 65,000 runners-up.

From March 6 to March 20 you can submit your entry for the Half Marathon. One Mile and 5K will go for sale in late April.

The World Athletics Road Running Championships Copenhagen 26 is hosted for World Athletics by Danish Athletics and Sparta Athletics & Running, in collaboration with the City of Copenhagen, Sport Event Denmark, and Wonderful Copenhagen.
